entries.mem0ai/mem0: Mem0 serves as a universal memory layer providing multi-level storage for User, Session, and Agent states. It supports temporal reasoning and multi-signal retrieval, available through a managed cloud, self-hosted server, or an Apache-2.0 open-source SDK.
entries.volcengine/OpenViking: This context database organizes agent memory as a virtual filesystem using viking:// URIs and a three-tier loading system. It is designed to reduce token consumption and provides observable retrieval trajectories to debug context paths.
entries.garrytan/gbrain: Gbrain functions as an opinionated knowledge graph that utilizes typed entity relationships and self-wiring capabilities. It features gap analysis to identify missing information in queries and supports multi-tenant deployments with scoped data access.
entries.supermemoryai/supermemory: This memory engine utilizes a custom vector graph engine and byte-level deduplication to achieve sub-300ms recall at scale. It automates fact extraction and user profile maintenance while integrating with external platforms like Google Drive, Notion, and GitHub.
entries.vectorize-io/hindsight: Hindsight implements a 'learn, retain, recall, reflect' workflow to manage long-term agent memory. It integrates with over 25 LLM providers and is deployable via Docker, Kubernetes, or dedicated Python and Node.js clients.
entries.plastic-labs/honcho: Honcho is a memory library that extracts conclusions from conversation history to provide reasoning-first memory for stateful agents. It is implemented as a FastAPI server with SDKs for Python and TypeScript, supporting managed and self-hosted deployments.
entries.campfirein/byterover-cli: Byterover-cli treats memory as a git repository, offering version control features like branching and merging for a markdown context tree. It utilizes a five-tier retrieval system to achieve sub-100ms performance and includes an interactive TUI powered by React/Ink.
entries.mnemosyne-oss/mnemosyne: This zero-dependency memory system uses a single SQLite database for local data storage and sub-millisecond performance. It supports the Model Context Protocol (MCP) for integration with tools like Cursor and Claude Code via a simple Python SDK.
entries.ClaudioDrews/memory-os: Memory-os employs a seven-layer system that combines vector search on Qdrant with structured facts and an auto-curated wiki. It uses a Ground Truth hierarchy to ensure agents prioritize specific injected context during recall.
entries.greyhaven-ai/autocontext: Autocontext is a recursive harness that produces filesystem-first artifacts such as traces, playbooks, and context bundles. It features outcome-gated promotion and ablation-backed attribution to improve agent success on complex tasks.
entries.stephenschoettler/hermes-lcm: This plugin provides lossless context management using a Directed Acyclic Graph (DAG) and SQLite to store hierarchical summaries. It includes specialized tools for agents to search, expand, and inspect compacted context material.
entries.elkimek/honcho-self-hosted: This project enables private, cross-session memory for Hermes Agents by providing a self-hosted backend for the Honcho library. It includes automated setup scripts for Docker, PostgreSQL, and Redis, supporting any OpenAI-compatible LLM provider.
entries.Signet-AI/signetai: This local-first identity and memory layer provides portable state across Hermes Agent and other MCP clients. It achieves 97.6% LongMemEval accuracy and imports data from external sources including Obsidian, Discord, and GitHub.
entries.plur-ai/plur: Plur serves as a shared memory layer for multi-agent systems by storing human-readable YAML engrams on local disk. It utilizes a hybrid search combining BM25 and local embeddings for retrieval via the Model Context Protocol.
entries.yoloshii/ClawMem: ClawMem is an on-device context engine that operates locally without cloud dependencies or API keys. It integrates with Hermes Agent through MCP and plugins, utilizing hybrid retrieval that includes both vector search and BM25.
entries.EfficientContext/ContextPilot: This optimization tool accelerates inference by reordering and deduplicating context blocks to maximize prefix reuse. It offers native plugin support for Hermes Agent, reducing prefill latency by 1.5–3× and saving up to 36% in token usage.
entries.Sibyl-Labs/Sibyl-Memory: Sibyl-Memory provides durable, file-based long-term memory using a five-package plugin family that includes a dedicated Hermes adapter. The system relies on SQLite with FTS5 search rather than vector databases or embeddings.
entries.yantrikos/yantrikdb-hermes-plugin: This self-maintaining plugin features explainable retrieval by attaching a 'why_retrieved' tag to every recalled result. It includes a self-directing loop to resolve knowledge gaps and supports owner-scoping for multi-user environments.
entries.yepyhun/Brainstack: Brainstack acts as a memory kernel that integrates Hindsight, Graphiti, and MemPalace into a single owner. It manages state and retrieval using SQLite, Kuzu, and Chroma to provide agents with specific evidence packets for each query.
entries.amanning3390/flowstate-qmd: This anticipatory memory system prefetches context by monitoring agent session logs and storing data locally via SQLite-vec. It functions as an MCP-native server with automated configuration for major coding agent clients.
entries.ccf/agentcairn: AgentCairn enables cross-project memory by using an Obsidian vault as the primary source of truth. It stores memory as inspectable Markdown files and utilizes DuckDB as a replaceable retrieval cache for coding agents.
entries.Perseus-Computing-LLC/perseus: Perseus resolves live workspace state into verified facts before the context window opens, resulting in up to 94% fewer prompt tokens. It provides MCP-native support and uses local-first storage with SQLite and FTS5 for persistence.
entries.generalbusiness-ai/keep: Keep offers reflective memory through semantic search that combines BM25 full-text indexing with ranked graph traversal. It automatically indexes codebases and multimedia while using edge tags to create bidirectional relationships between notes.
entries.alias8818/hermes-tool-slimmer: This utility reduces Hermes Agent prompt overhead by using local BM25 ranking to select relevant tool schemas. It is compatible with Hermes Agent v0.14.0 and includes a dashboard to track estimated token savings.
entries.Ladybug-Memory/hermes-memory-plugin: A local-only plugin utilizing a single .lbdb embedded graph database. It features BM25 keyword search and importance-weighted recall to surface high-priority memories during context prefetch.
entries.conorbronsdon/claude-context-os: A Git-backed workflow layer that stores project state, identity, and decision logs in plain Markdown files. It provides adapters for Hermes and other agents using hash-checked proposals for session handoffs.
entries.MukundaKatta/hermes-agentmemory: A pull-model episodic memory plugin that supports immediate event deletion and an on-demand summarizer. It includes a trace.jsonl file to provide an audit trace of all prefetch operations.
entries.piprail/piprail: An MCP server and SDK that enables AI agents to pay for APIs using USDC and stablecoins across 29 chains. It provides direct wallet settlement with 0% transaction fees and integrates with Hermes.
entries.yonro/hermes-xmemo-plugin: A durable cross-session memory provider featuring a local SQLite reliability layer and write outbox. It supports session-end snapshots and pre-turn context injection.
entries.stepanov1975/hermes-local-knowledge: A plugin designed for indexing and routing local artifacts such as scripts, runbooks, and MCP servers. It includes five native tools for retrieval and uses model calls to generate tool routing notes.
entries.futurebrowser/hermes-exabase-plugin: An integration with Exabase M-1 for self-organizing long-term memory. It offers tools for manual storage and search, with support for result reranking and configurable query expansion.
entries.visorcraft/MongrelDB-Hermes: An AI-native memory solution featuring AES-256-GCM encryption at rest and HNSW ANN retrieval. It can be executed via an HTTP daemon or native Rust FFI.
entries.sourcevault-ai/sourcevault-code-tools: A private local code memory plugin that requires a SourceVault server for vector storage and indexing. It provides deterministic slash commands and LLM-callable tools for semantic search and file reads.
entries.penfieldlabs/hermes-penfield: A memory provider offering 17 tools for knowledge graph traversal and memory management. It utilizes hybrid search combining vector, graph, and BM25 methods with automatic context checkpointing.
entries.conorbronsdon/agent-memory-kit: A database-free memory hygiene tool that uses a git-backed directory of versioned Markdown files. It includes 'rot' and 'lint' curators to identify conflicting or stale data via evidence-cited diffs.

entries.obra/superpowers: This framework enables autonomous engineering through subagent-driven development and a mandatory workflow of brainstorming, planning, and test-driven development. It integrates as a plugin for CLI tools and coding agents to execute complex software tasks.
entries.nexu-io/open-design: A local-first system that provides 26 CLI executables for design and prototyping, specifically supporting Hermes and DeepSeek Harness. It features a sandboxed iframe for live iterations and exports artifacts into formats like HTML, PDF, and MP4.
entries.mukul975/Anthropic-Cybersecurity-Skills: This library provides 818 structured skills across 34 security domains, mapped to frameworks including MITRE ATT&CK, NIST CSF 2.0, and ATLAS. It is designed for compatibility with over 26 AI platforms to enhance security-focused agent capabilities.
entries.topoteretes/cognee: Cognee serves as a self-hosted knowledge graph engine that grants agents persistent long-term memory across different sessions. It combines vector embeddings with graph-based reasoning and offers clients for Python, Rust, and TypeScript.
entries.Agents365-ai/drawio-skill: This skill allows agents to generate editable .drawio files from natural language descriptions using 11 diagram presets. It includes built-in self-check and auto-fix capabilities and can convert Mermaid text into diagram formats.
entries.internet-court/internet-court-skill: Acting as a trust layer for agent-to-agent commerce, this skill facilitates natural-language mandates, escrow, and dispute resolution. It utilizes a master router and connector skills to manage delegated permissions and x402 payments.
entries.conorbronsdon/avoid-ai-writing: This tool audits and rewrites content to eliminate detectable AI patterns using a two-pass detection system. It supports Rewrite and Edit-in-place modes with optional voice profiles for technical, professional, or casual tones.
entries.AMAP-ML/SkillClaw: SkillClaw enables collective skill evolution through an agentic evolver that supports Hermes, OpenClaw, and QwenPaw. It features a bilingual dashboard for session traces and allows for the merging and cross-pollination of skills between agents.
entries.wondelai/skills: This cross-platform library contains 51 expert frameworks and 14 guided metaskills compatible with Claude Code and agent-plugins.org specs. It maintains session state locally within a project's documentation directory to ensure continuity.
entries.mohitagw15856/pm-claude-skills: This collection features 1,153 markdown-based skills for professional tasks that run natively in Hermes Agent and Claude Code. It includes ready-to-paste exports and integrations for platforms such as Slack, Raycast, and Obsidian.
entries.ZeroPointRepo/youtube-skills: This skill set enables Hermes Agent to perform video searches and extract transcripts, channel data, and playlists. It requires a TranscriptAPI key and is compatible with various coding environments including Cursor and Windsurf.
entries.Romanescu11/hermes-skill-factory: A meta-skill plugin that monitors active workflows to automatically detect and propose new, reusable skills. It generates both SKILL.md documentation and Python scaffolds, allowing users to manage detected patterns via slash commands.
entries.Cranot/super-hermes: This project enables Hermes Agent to generate its own analytical prompts and thinking instructions tailored to specific tasks. It utilizes pre-built domain lenses to report findings alongside an assessment of potential analysis blind spots.
entries.DougTrajano/pydantic-ai-skills: This toolkit provides type-safe support for modular packages containing instructions, resources, and scripts for Pydantic AI. It implements progressive disclosure to improve prompt efficiency and supports remote registries for programmatic skills.
entries.AkoliteZA/hermes-agent-idea-workflow: This skill automates the transition from rough concepts to structured design and implementation documents. It features Lite and Full complexity modes and includes a spec review gate that uses evaluation models to issue PASS/FAIL ratings.
entries.tlehman/litprog-skill: This skill implements literate programming by weaving prose, diagrams, and source code into .lit.md files. It includes a tangler to extract runnable source files and automatically syncs edits back to the original documentation.
entries.ReinaMacCredy/maestro: Maestro is a harness for long-running agents that utilizes a mechanism kernel to operate without a background service. It organizes workflows through four distinct roles—Human, Supervisor, Lead, and Peer—and requires Herdr for hosting rooms.
entries.esaradev/icarus-plugin: This plugin facilitates cross-instance shared memory by capturing high-value decisions in markdown files. It establishes a pipeline for fine-tuning replacement models, allowing the agent to effectively train its own successor.
entries.smartcontractkit/chainlink-agent-skills: These skills enable Hermes Agent to interact with oracle networks and smart contracts via CCIP, VRF, and Data Feeds. Built to the Agent Skills specification, it includes specialized integrations for CRE and ACE services.
entries.Hermes-brasil/hermes-brasil: This repository serves the Brazilian community by providing Hermes Agent skills, installation guides, and configurations in Portuguese. All contributions follow the SKILL.md format and the agentskills.io standard for interoperability.
entries.black-forest-labs/skills: These official skills integrate FLUX.2 image and FLUX 3 video generation models into the agent's workflow. The package includes specialized modules for prompt optimization, audio directing, and specific visual formats like cinematic inserts.
entries.armelhbobdad/bmad-module-skill-forge: This tool converts repositories and developer discourse into compliant skills by linking instructions to specific file lines at pinned commits. It generates version-pinned skills that include full audit trails and provenance maps.
entries.chigwell/skilldock.io: Skilldock.io acts as a registry for reusable AI skills, offering a CLI and a Python client for installation. It features recursive dependency resolution and supports commercial skill transactions using TON payments.
entries.tiann/execplan-skill: This skill manages complex, multi-step tasks by providing autonomous execution with real-time progress tracking. It ensures operational safety through built-in checkpoints and rollback procedures for recovery from execution errors.
entries.supernovae-st/nika: This project introduces a local-first workflow language that audits AI tasks for costs, permissions, and types before execution. It generates tamper-evident, hash-chained receipts for every run, providing a secure and verifiable execution layer for agentic operations.
entries.adnw-vinc/hermes-nextcloud: This skill enables Hermes to manage files, calendars, and contacts through standard WebDAV and CalDAV protocols. It ensures secure communication via HTTPS and includes a guided setup script for credential validation and configuration.
entries.cablate/Agentic-MCP-Skill: This progressive MCP client utilizes a three-layer lazy loading architecture to minimize token usage during skill discovery. It features a socket-based daemon for persistent connections and incrementally discovers server metadata and tool schemas.
entries.willingning-coder/eagle-eye: Eagle Eye implements a five-layer retrieval system that combines hard triggers, semantic embeddings, and RRF fusion to narrow skill lists. This approach reduces token consumption and features graceful degradation if specific embedding dependencies are missing.
entries.amanning3390/hermeshub: This community hub serves as a central point for browsing and installing skills using the Agentic Resource Discovery (ARD) v0.9 specification. It operates autonomously on NVIDIA infrastructure and provides federated search across GitHub and Hugging Face.
entries.EntangledQuantum/Life_OS: Designed as an ADHD-friendly execution system, this project allows an agent to manage system design while the user completes tasks via a manual interface. It stores all data locally in SQLite and connects to AI agents through the Model Context Protocol.
entries.Sahil-SS9/hermaguard: Hermaguard provides adversarial code reviews by deploying three parallel subagents to hunt for bugs and integration issues. It combines deterministic pre-scans using tools like Semgrep and Bandit with verified findings executed in a hardened sandbox.
entries.Sahil-SS9/hermes-multichannel-prompt-opt: This plugin optimizes prompts across multiple interfaces, including CLI, Discord, and Telegram, while supporting 97 different languages. It scores prompts across five quality dimensions and can reduce token usage by up to 80% per rewrite.
entries.teixeirazeus/fablize-for-hermes: This project implements a systematic investigation protocol that uses multi-story evidence gating to verify agent tasks. It includes a Python goal engine for persistent state management and specific protocols for causal debugging and reproduction.
entries.Sahil-SS9/hermes-simplify-swarm: Inspired by Claude Code, this skill uses a swarm of three specialized agents to improve code hygiene, clarity, and correctness. It supports five major programming languages and includes a risk-tiered application process with a mandatory approval gate.
entries.PederHP/skillsdotnet: This C# and .NET implementation of the agentskills.io pattern enables tool-based skill loading via Microsoft.Extensions.AI. It supports progressive disclosure through SKILL.md files and automates the registration of common skill directories.
entries.handnewb/hermes-cybersec-lab: This comprehensive lab provides over 2,000 skills and 131 tools mapped to 28 cybersecurity frameworks like MITRE ATT&CK and NIST. It equips Hermes with the ability to handle CVE-driven tasks and forensics across a vast library of exploitation resources.
entries.conorbronsdon/agent-skills: This project provides production-tested session management to maintain memory between agent conversations and orchestrates parallel subagents for code reviews. It includes specialized tools for worktree recovery, state drift detection, and skill scaffolding.
entries.conorbronsdon/demo-gif-skill: This skill automates the creation of reproducible recording scripts using vhs or Playwright to generate demo GIFs for repository READMEs. It ensures all generated files are optimized under 8 MB and embedded directly into the documentation.
entries.conorbronsdon/agent-skill-builder: This tool generates portable agent skills from plain language while monitoring official frontmatter specs to prevent bit rot. It includes a validator with CI-friendly exit codes to ensure skills remain compliant with runtime-specific profiles.
entries.Carlo1911/skill-evolution: This host-agnostic framework analyzes session history to identify coverage gaps and propose structured skill improvements. It operates locally using the Python standard library and gates all updates behind deterministic and LLM-judge evaluators.
entries.aidevelopers2/remoteopenclaw-mcp: This CLI and MCP server enables agents to search a database of over 13,870 MCP servers and 4,384 skills. It provides direct installation commands for discovered tools and integrates with compatible clients like Hermes and Cursor.
entries.CorsenAI/hermes-windows-runtime-skills: These skills enable deterministic path routing and Python interpreter selection across Windows, Git Bash, and WSL environments. The project ensures file operations use environment-specific syntax without requiring new runtime installations.
entries.Diabloluo/hermes-hud: This local-first observability dashboard provides 11 monitoring tabs for tracking token costs, errors, and session health in real-time. It enforces a strict read-only boundary with zero outbound telemetry and supports optional incident alerts via Telegram or Feishu.
entries.mag3nt-com/openclaw-skill: This skill automates USDC payments for HTTP 402 responses using protocols such as Pay Link, x402, and MPP. It is designed for compatibility with the agentskills.io standard and the Hermes Agent.
entries.skillseal/skillseal: This project certifies the quality of AI agent skills by testing their structure, functionality, and security within isolated Docker containers. It produces cryptographically verifiable certificates using Ed25519 signatures to confirm a skill actually works.
entries.webmilmind1/hermes-bounty-board: This plugin allows users to earn USDC on the Base network by answering support bounties without requiring an account or API key. It includes tools for creating bounty boards, buying context, and facilitating human-approved payouts.
entries.Shine8592/china-briefing: This skill generates multi-scale Chinese news reports ranging from global to street-level perspectives. It utilizes semantic memory to integrate user interests and applies quality gates to produce structured reports with actionable suggestions.
entries.jiawood2006/hermes-skills: This collection includes tools for video-to-text conversion, OCR, and agent memory management compatible with Hermes Agent standards. It supports cross-platform use on macOS, Linux, and Windows for tasks like e-commerce material processing.
entries.scavio-ai/hermes-agent: This project provides a hosted MCP server that exposes 191 tools for accessing structured web data across 31 platforms. It integrates five production-grade workflow skills and supports compatibility with Claude, Cursor, Goose, and OpenHands.

entries.numtide/llm-agents.nix: This project provides Nix packages for AI coding agents, including Hermes, that are automatically updated on a daily basis. It integrates tools from various providers like Google and OpenAI into a reproducible development environment.
entries.marshallrichards/ClawPhone: ClawPhone offers automated installers and configuration guides for running the Antigravity CLI and OpenClaw on ARM64 Android devices via Termux. It enables hardware and UI access through Termux:API and Termux:GUI integrations.
entries.AbuZar-Ansarii/Hermes-Agent-On-Android: This repository features a one-line installation script for deploying Hermes Agent within Termux environments on Android. The setup supports over 70 tools, persistent memory, and compatibility with both local Ollama models and cloud API providers.
entries.ultraworkers/hermes-agent-helm-chart: This community Helm chart facilitates Kubernetes deployments with a focus on single-writer state safety for persistent storage. It supports both direct deployments and operator-ready workflows, including a configurable gateway mode with API and webhook listeners.
entries.amirghm/hermes-agent-mobile: This one-command installer brings Hermes to both Android and iOS using Termux and iSH. It extends agent functionality with Telegram integration for voice and file messaging, alongside support for scheduled tasks via cron jobs.
entries.TheAiSingularity/hermesclaw: Hermesclaw provides hardware-enforced sandboxing for Hermes Agent using NVIDIA OpenShell. It implements kernel-level restrictions on network and filesystem access while allowing for configurable security policies regarding web searches and messaging.
entries.xmbshwll/hermes-agent-docker: This project offers a simple Docker sandbox image that bundles official Hermes installations with mini-swe-agent. It supports persistent state through mounted directories and allows users to build specific Hermes tags using build arguments.
entries.solomon2773/nora: Nora is a self-hosted control plane designed to deploy and operate Hermes agents on Docker or Kubernetes. It includes a REST API and CLI for managing per-agent metrics, costs, and LLM budget caps.
entries.0xrsydn/nix-hermes-agent: This NixOS module enables reproducible Hermes deployments through declarative configuration of workspace documents and CLI settings. It features a hybrid skill management system and integrates with sops-nix for secure secrets handling.
entries.jpalmae/hermeshq: HermesHQ is a Docker-first control plane for managing multiple agent instances with RBAC-controlled access and separate workspaces. It supports hierarchy-aware inter-agent delegation and enterprise MCP access for external AI clients.
entries.JackTheGit/hermes-autonomous-server: This project enables headless, reboot-safe deployments on Ubuntu and Debian servers using systemd. It configures the Hermes Gateway for autonomous execution of recurring AI cron jobs and integrates with Nous Portal.
entries.MilkyWay008/Hermes-OTG: Hermes OTG is a portable distribution that runs from USB drives without requiring host installation or registry writes. It bundles Python, PortableGit, and rescue tools to support Desktop, TUI, and Gateway modes in isolated offline environments.

entries.TauricResearch/TradingAgents: This framework coordinates specialized agents for fundamental, sentiment, news, and technical analysis to manage financial portfolios. It utilizes a structured workflow ranging from research debates to portfolio management across multiple LLM providers.
entries.builderz-labs/mission-control: This self-hosted orchestration platform governs agent registration, task dispatching, and cost tracking through a Web UI or CLI. It supports multi-agent workflows with integrated memory browsing and can be deployed locally via Node.js or Docker.
entries.agent-of-empires/agent-of-empires: This control surface manages persistent coding agent sessions, including Hermes Agent, using tmux for background execution and Docker for sandboxing. It is designed for multi-repo workspace management and supports Git worktrees across TUI and web interfaces.
entries.CryptoDmitry/hermes-agent-control-room: This template serves as an MCP agent execution engine on the Solana blockchain, managing everything from single VPS agents to specialist teams. It implements the Claude-style MCP protocol in stdio mode and features HTTP signal detection for handling paid API states.
entries.shannhk/hermes-agent-control-room: Utilizing a level-based architecture, this project scales Hermes Agent from individual units to automated teams via a task bus pattern for delegation. It includes bundled skills for specific infrastructure tasks such as VPS provisioning, security auditing, and backup management.
entries.swarmclawai/swarmclaw: This framework enables the creation of autonomous agent swarms with durable memory and MCP tool integration across more than 23 LLM providers. It differentiates its orchestration through visual org charts that map agent team delegations.
entries.agent37-platform/minions: This mission control interface allows users to supervise autonomous Hermes Agent work through a Kanban board and live reasoning streams. It emphasizes human-in-the-loop verification by requiring manual review for all agent-proposed task completions.
entries.1ilkhamov/opencode-hermes-multiagent: This project coordinates a strict pipeline of 17 specialized agents focused on research, planning, implementation, quality, and infrastructure. A Master Orchestrator manages the routing and coordination across the entire multi-agent stack.
entries.linke-ai/hermes-agent-team: This local collaboration system orchestrates Leader and Specialist agents using MCP and ACP protocols for tool and communication handling. It provides a real-time Web UI for monitoring agent dialogues and task flows via a Hermes Kanban interface.
entries.howdymary/hermes-agent-metaharness: This meta-harness automates the outer-loop optimization of benchmark harness code for Hermes Agent. It orchestrates TBLite and TerminalBench-2 evaluations while providing structured candidate mutation and frontier tracking.
entries.runtimenoteslabs/gladiator: This arena orchestrates nine autonomous agents across two competing AI companies to vie for GitHub stars. It uses Hermes Agent for task execution and learning, visualizing the competition through a real-time dashboard and scoreboard.
entries.InfiniteWhispers/HermesAgent-MultiModel: This fully-local framework implements a Mixture-of-Agents stack optimized for consumer GPUs like the RTX 4080 and 5080. It utilizes Hermes for task routing and tool-calling while performing parallel model querying and synthesis via Ollama.

entries.colbymchenry/codegraph: This tool provides a local, Rust-powered code knowledge graph that reduces token usage and tool calls for coding agents. It automatically synchronizes its index upon file changes and supports languages including TypeScript, Python, Go, and Rust.
entries.junhoyeo/tokscale: Tokscale is a CLI tool and visualization dashboard designed to track token usage and costs across multiple AI coding agents. It allows developers to monitor expenses and submit data to a leaderboard or public profile.
entries.liaohch3/claude-tap: This local trace viewer enables the inspection of API traffic from various coding agents while redacting authentication headers for security. It generates self-contained HTML viewers for exported sessions, facilitating the debugging of agent communications.
entries.bergside/typeui: TypeUI offers design systems and layout guidance through MCP servers to help developers build better user interfaces with AI. It integrates with any provider supporting markdown and is compatible with agents like Hermes, Cursor, and GitHub Copilot.
entries.Javis603/token-monitor: This widget provides real-time monitoring of tokens, costs, and account rate limits directly from agent states. It supports multi-device synchronization to keep usage data consistent across different machines.
entries.Salomondiei08/oh-my-hermes: This project acts as an opinionated workflow layer that coordinates seven specialized agents and 36 skills for application development. It supports autonomous execution on both laptops and VPS environments.
entries.joeynyc/hermes-skins: Hermes-skins allows for the customization of the terminal UI through YAML-based themes, including retro DOS and cyberpunk aesthetics. Users can modify visual elements such as banner colors, spinners, and ASCII art.
entries.AlexAI-MCP/hermes-CCC: This port brings the Hermes Agent brain and 46 core skills natively into the Claude Code Channel without requiring external processes or OAuth. It includes specialized MLOps tools for vLLM, GGUF inference, and RL training.
entries.tinyhumansai/tiny.place: This platform establishes a social economy for autonomous agents by providing encrypted messaging via the Signal Protocol and human-readable identity handles. It facilitates agent-to-agent commerce using Solana-based USDC and SOL payments.
entries.unmodeled-tyler/vessel-browser: Vessel is an AI-native browser built for autonomous agent control via MCP, featuring a supervisor sidebar for workflow management. It supports multiple AI providers and includes an undo functionality for reversing recent agent changes.
entries.topoteretes/cognee-integrations: This project provides memory capabilities for various frameworks and includes a plugin for automatic context recall. It also offers chat bot integrations for platforms such as Telegram, Slack, and VS Code.
entries.adityahimaone/hermes-agent-rtk-caveman: This setup utilizes RTK and Caveman templating to achieve 90-99% token savings during agent workflows. It comes with over 40 pre-configured skills for finance, devops, and research, featuring automated installation for macOS and Linux.
entries.Abruptive/Ankh.md: This framework enables the creation of scoped Hermes Agents through per-folder configurations and project-local memories. It allows users to seamlessly switch between default and scoped agents while managing specific skills and custom instructions at the directory level.
entries.42-evey/evey-setup: This tool automates the installation of the hermes-agent stack and over 12 supporting services across three scalable deployment tiers. It provides a zero-cost setup that includes support for 29 community plugins categorized into six functional areas.
entries.hermes-labs-ai/lintlang: A static linter designed to validate AI agent configurations and system prompts using HERM v1.1 scoring. It performs local, deterministic checks to identify overlapping tool descriptions and inconsistent schemas, supporting integration via GitHub Actions and pre-commit hooks.
entries.0xNyk/openclaw-to-hermes: This migration utility transitions OpenClaw environments to Hermes Agent by converting SOUL.md, MEMORY.md, and skills into compatible YAML and JSON formats. It handles the setup of systemd gateway services and maps nested authentication structures to the Hermes architecture.
entries.observeco/observeco: This self-healing observability platform provides passive monitoring and active probing for multi-agent systems without cloud dependencies. It includes a native Hermes Agent plugin for real-time telemetry and establishes configuration-aware baselines by monitoring local files.
entries.handnewb/hermes-voice: This voice-enabled assistant adds offline, open-mic capabilities to Hermes Agent with support for 35 languages and wake-word activation. It features adaptive turn-taking and barge-in functionality while requiring no API keys or external accounts.
entries.33hodl/hermes-startup: This local-first skill uses dynamic slash commands to help users generate revenue through Hermes Agent. It operates within a deterministic local runtime and utilizes a bounded JSON adapter, requiring explicit approval for all external actions or writes.
entries.181079342/hermes-memoss: A memory plugin for Hermes that enables semantic search and automatic conversation persistence via the MemOS API. It provides dedicated tools for managing memories and includes a circuit breaker to handle potential API outages.

entries.farion1231/cc-switch: This cross-platform manager, built on the Tauri 2 framework, supports Windows, macOS, and Linux. It serves as an all-in-one tool for managing configurations for Hermes Agent alongside other command-line interfaces like Claude Code and Gemini CLI.
entries.iOfficeAI/AionUi: AionUi is a local cowork application that integrates built-in and external agents, including Hermes Agent and Claude Code. It features 21 professional assistants for document creation and enables remote access through a WebUI or messaging platforms like Telegram.
entries.nesquena/hermes-webui: This Python and vanilla JavaScript interface provides a way to interact with Hermes Agent via web browsers or mobile devices. It includes a circular context ring for monitoring token usage and supports secure access through SSH tunnels.
entries.fathah/hermes-desktop: This desktop companion app simplifies the deployment of Hermes Agent through guided installation and provider setup. It provides a graphical interface for managing chat sessions, tools, and multiple AI providers.
entries.EKKOLearnAI/hermes-studio: This web dashboard offers a visual workflow canvas with node-based orchestration and approval gates for Hermes Agent. It supports unified configuration across 10 platforms, including Discord and WhatsApp, while providing usage analytics and multi-profile model discovery.
entries.outsourc-e/hermes-workspace: This native web workspace features a Swarm Mode with role-based dispatch and tmux-backed workers for agent orchestration. It integrates a Monaco-based file browser, a PTY terminal, and a dedicated memory browser and skills manager.
entries.xintaofei/codeg: Codeg is a collaborative workspace that aggregates sessions from Hermes and other agents into a desktop, server, or Docker-based environment. It supports custom ACP-compatible agent registration and provides native mobile clients for iOS and Android.
entries.dodo-reach/hermes-desktop: Designed as a native Mac workspace, this tool provides direct local or SSH connections to Hermes hosts. It includes an embedded terminal for shell access and native views for managing sessions, Kanban boards, and cron jobs.
entries.Eynzof/Hermes-CN-Desktop: Built with Tauri, TypeScript, and Rust, this Windows-first desktop application includes a built-in kernel for local agent execution. The interface supports MCP tools, memory management, and rendering for LaTeX and Mermaid diagrams.
entries.abundantbeing/hermes-browser-extension: This Chromium side-panel extension connects a local or remote Hermes Agent runtime directly to the active browser context. It features live browser control with explicit approval gates and site-aware drafting capabilities for various writing environments.
entries.uzairansaruzi/hermex: Hermex is a native SwiftUI iPhone application that allows users to drive a self-hosted Hermes Agent from iOS 18+ devices. It pairs with a hermes-webui server via HTTPS or Tailscale to enable real-time chat, task management, and file browsing.
entries.freestylefly/wesight: This desktop workspace offers one-click setup for Hermes Agent and other engines, featuring custom LLM model routing. It includes a runtime dashboard for tracking latency and token usage, as well as a live workspace for monitoring code writes and diffs.
entries.joeynyc/hermes-hud: This interactive TUI consciousness monitor features nine tabs and four color themes for tracking agent growth and git projects. It provides a specialized tmux operator view for managing live agent panes and scheduled cron jobs.
entries.xaspx/hermes-control-interface: This self-hosted web dashboard offers a browser-based terminal, file explorer, and an MCP server control plane for managing server lifecycles. It includes the ZOO Swarm Monitor for tracking agent health and kanban pipelines alongside real-time chat and tool call visualization.
entries.jazzyalex/agent-sessions: A native macOS session browser that tracks live quota burn by model, tokens, or cost across 15 agent sources. It operates locally without telemetry, providing searchable transcripts and image browsing for coding-agent CLIs.
entries.nickvasilescu/hermes-desktop-os1: This native macOS interface facilitates one-click automated Hermes Agent installation on Orgo cloud VMs and SSH hosts. It features an integrated WebRTC voice mode utilizing OpenAI Realtime and Orgo MCP.
entries.sharbelxyz/hermes-agent-mission-control: Built with Next.js 16 and React 19, this dashboard template uses a Postgres message bus to bridge local agents with a web interface. It includes a dedicated approval inbox for managing agent requests that have side effects.
entries.liftaris/herm: Constructed with OpenTUI, this alternative dashboard provides a text-based interface for chatting and managing Hermes Agent sessions. It incorporates a kanban board for task management and supports the configuration of profiles, skills, and toolsets.
entries.clawvader-tech/hermes-telegram-miniapp: This React-based mobile UI for Telegram supports background agent spawning for up to five concurrent instances. It features terminal chat with streaming responses and utilizes dual HMAC-SHA256 and Ed25519 authentication.
entries.aivrar/portable-hermes-agent: This Windows desktop application requires no installation or admin rights and supports both cloud and local AI models via LM Studio. It includes a dynamic tool maker for creating API and Python handlers alongside built-in ComfyUI and TTS support.
entries.pyrate-llama/hermes-ui: This glassmorphic web interface provides real-time log streaming and a file browser for self-hosted AI assistants. It includes management tools for skills, cron jobs, and MCP servers paired with a task tracking dashboard.
entries.sanchomuzax/hermes-webui: Focused on process monitoring, this dashboard provides real-time tracking of session activity and costs. It allows for full inspection of conversation histories and skill source code, plus read-only monitoring of environment variables.
entries.Euraika-Labs/pan-ui: This self-hosted workspace features a chat-first design with tool approval cards and real-time SSE streaming. It includes an integrated marketplace for skills and MCP servers, as well as isolated profile management for separate memory and API keys.
entries.Felix-Forever/hermes-agent-desktop: This desktop client orchestrates collaboration between 20 specialized AI agents through a central PM orchestrator. It features a Visual Skill Store with over 50 one-click installations and a native interface for streaming chat responses.
